correctness.rationale: Proved for every integer n>=7 by a full face partition into Δ4,n and exactly 2n bent-edge cones; each link is a connected crown graph with n²-5n+5 cycles; the shellability theorem gives Δ4,n as a 2-connected wedge of 3-spheres, so all two-dimensional attaching maps are null. Count of sphere multiplicities follows by exact Euler algebra. Independent exhaustive face and GF2 boundary computations agree for n=7,8,9; these are checks, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Classifies an unbounded, natural family of bidirectional graph multipath complexes and its integral homotopy type; makes explicit how additional directed two-paths alter familiar chessboard topology by 2n connected crown links. The n>=7 stable shellability threshold explains an infinite torsion-free regime, contrasting with difficult low-parameter behavior. No arbitrary slice or tiny parameter increment is needed; the natural all-n>=7 range is furnished by a structural theorem.
